sloka: अथ जीज्ञाससे माम् त्वम् भरतस्य प्रियाप्रिये ।अस्तुयत्तत्त्वयाअपूर्वम् व्याहृतम्राघवम्प्रति ॥२-१२-१६॥
transliteration: atha jījñāsase mām tvam bharatasya priyāpriye ।astuyattattvayāapūrvam vyāhṛtamrāghavamprati ॥2-12-16॥

translations.english: O sinful one why have you got this most dreadful thought? Do you want to know my likes or dislikes about Bharata? Let them be so.But speaking of Rama earlier, you used to say, 'Rama is my eldest son. He is noble and foremost in discharging his duties.' Such sweet words could not have been said only to please me.
translations.hindi: है त श्रीरामचन्द्र के अभिषेक के लिए सब तैयारियाँ हो को ६। इस प्रकार लोग आपस में कह रहे थे कि आस बड़े राजाओं से
